Container.Name: whatsapp-seerr
Container.Overview: Bridge WhatsApp to Overseerr/Jellyseerr so users can request movies and TV shows from a WhatsApp chat. Includes a web UI for configuration.
Container.Description:
Connect a WhatsApp account and let users request media from chat. Features a full web UI for setup, an optional allowed-numbers whitelist, and persistent WhatsApp sessions (no re-scanning on restart).

Add --shm-size=1gb to Extra Parameters if the container logs "Navigating frame was detached" - Chromium's renderer crashes with Docker's default 64MB /dev/shm.

Chat commands: !request movie <title>, !request tv <title>, !pick <n>, !help.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: whatsapp overseerr jellyseerr seerr media request bridge bot
